mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the observed periods.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) and a strong labor market (PAYEMS > 145,000) amplifies consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong labor market
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 1.5% and PAYEMS > 145,000, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the observed periods.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200 units signal robust consumer demand for housing, which translates to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, when HOUST exceeds 1200, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the observed periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing and supply chain activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO exceeds 105, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the observed periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 245) signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 245, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the observed periods.

mechanism_narrative: In moderate inflation environments (CPIAUCSL < 250), strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 480,000) indicates sustained economic momentum, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL < 250 and RSAFS > 480,000, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the observed periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 245) signals persistent inflationary pressures, leading the Federal Reserve to implement tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 245, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the observed periods.
